summary: A friend asks the player to meet while deciding whether to run for office.
realLife: Before settling on a race in 1952, John Kennedy asked Thomas Costin to meet at his Boston apartment. Kennedy wanted Costin to host a gathering in Lynn while a Senate run and a race for governor were both possibilities.
inGame: needs: a prospective candidacy that can cause the meeting before filing.
gates: The friend is considering an eligible office.

turns.what: The friend arrives with a decision to stay out of the race.
turns.pulledBy: They have checked the filing calendar against a family commitment.
turns.writesBack: The meeting ends with no candidacy.

turns.what: Over coffee the friend offers a living room for a few introductions but asks to leave the office off the invitation.
turns.pulledBy: The prospective candidate is still considering two races and has announced neither.
turns.writesBack: The invitation describes a private gathering and the campaign record leaves the choice of office open.
